title: Space Tech Briefing — August 19, 2026
summary:
Good morning, space enthusiasts! Welcome to your daily dose of the cosmos, live from Space Tech Radio on this incredible Wednesday, August 19, 2026! We've got some truly stellar highlights to bring you up to speed on this morning.

First up, let's recap a truly historic moment from just yesterday, August 18th. European Space Agency astronaut Sophie Adenot achieved a monumental milestone in her mission aboard the International Space Station! She completed her very first spacewalk, stepping out into the vacuum of space for an incredible extravehicular activity, or EVA. This landmark event, a breathtaking moment for human spaceflight and for France's space agency, CNES, was broadcast live for the world to witness! What an achievement for Sophie and for space exploration!

And from one stunning visual to another, let's cast our minds back just a few days to August 12th. The total solar eclipse over Europe was, without a doubt, a truly fabulous spectacle for everyone lucky enough to witness it from Earth. But the views weren't limited to our planet's surface! Orbiting satellites and even observers from lunar orbit also enjoyed this rare celestial event, capturing some truly breathtaking perspectives of the moon's shadow sweeping across our world. A powerful reminder of the unique beauty our space assets allow us to behold!

That's all for your morning briefing on Space Tech Radio. Keep your eyes on the skies, and we'll be back tomorrow with more out-of-this-world news. Have a stellar day!
